# PRD-AI-02

**Are drift monitoring and at least one online eval switched on for every model-backed element?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | AI: Model and agent readiness |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Applies when | profiles include ai-solution |
| Reads | `elements.ai.drift_monitoring`, `elements.ai.evals.kind` |

## Rule

Every element with an ai facet has drift_monitoring and at least one eval of kind online.

## Sources

- NIST AI 600-1, Generative AI Profile (2024) (`nist-ai-600-1`)
- Azure Well-Architected Framework, AI workloads (`azure-ai`)
